'''Sleeper Cell V-16''' was a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents in the spaceport city of [[Fabrillan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malthor]]. They were regarded by [[Airen Cracken/Legends|General Cracken]] as a typical example of a group of "civilian [[operative]]s" who covertly aided the Alliance during their day-to-day activities.<ref name="CRO" />

The key figure in the cell was [[Berren Sid Té]], who had built himself up from a hawker to run a vast network of licensed vendors on the streets of Fabrillan, and used his extensive knowledge of the goings-on in the city to act as an [[information broker]].<ref name="CRO" />

However, this network was kept separate from the cell itself, which only had four other members - the heavy-drinking pilot [[Margo Flarestream]], smuggler-turned-spaceport-administrator [[Reginna Bel Typolla|Gina Typolla]], the axe-swinging, grenade-throwing alien enforcer [[Bakku]], and the droid-repair tech [[Spek-Man]].<ref name="CRO" />

The group had been recruited in such a way that its members were generally unaware of each other's identities, maintaining contact through dead-drops and intermediaries - even Sid, who seemed determined to know everything that was going on in Fabrillan, attempted, with varying levels of success, to keep his knowledge of the cell's other members to a minimum.<ref name="CRO" />

The cell was regarded by General Cracken as a very versatile and effective unit, combining an information-gathering role with various forms of expert support for Alliance agents on Malthor.<ref name="CRO" />
